questions_and_answers.question_text: What was the original meaning of hù?
What is kǒu the counter for, and what does it literally mean?
What must a production team sell to the state?
What is na a contraction of?
What special function does na have here?
Write the Chinese for "How many people are there in your family?"
Write the Chinese for "What a lively place!"
What happens to surplus grain after the quota is met?

answers.answer_text: The team decides for themselves how much to sell to the state at a higher price and how much to keep in reserves.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Write the Chinese for "Imagine, such a grown-up person crying!"

answers.answer_text: Zhème dàde rén hái kū na!

questions_and_answers.question_text: What percentage does a team pay in taxes?

answers.answer_text: Usually from five to seven percent of its produce and cash income.

articles.text:
5. A: Nèige shēngchǎn shūcàide dàduì The brigade that produces vegetables has
      zhǐ yǒu liùshí hù!             only sixty households!
   B: Shì a, èrbǎiduōkǒu rén        Yes, for two hundred people, they sell
      měinián mài gěi guójiā bù      a lot of vegetables to the state every
      shǎode cài na!                 year!

Notes on No. 5

hù(r): "household, family." The ORIGINAL meaning of this word was "DOOR." Now it has become the COUNTER for households.

Zhèige dàduì yǒu duōshao hù      How many households are there in this
rénjia?                          brigade?
Zài Měiguó, chàbuduō měihù dōu   In America, almost every family has a
yǒu diànshì.                     television.

kǒu: Literally "MOUTH," this is the COUNTER FOR PEOPLE considered as making up a FAMILY.

Nǐ jiā yǒu jǐkǒu rén?            How many people are there in your family?

mài gěi guójiā: "sell to the state." Every year a production team must give a certain percentage (usually five to seven percent) of its produce and cash income in TAXES to the state. In addition, they must SELL A QUOTA of grain to the state, the quantity established according to the population of the team and the productivity of the land. If the team has ADDITIONAL grain after fulfilling their quota, they decide THEMSELVES how much to sell for cash to the state at a HIGHER PRICE and how much to put into reserves.

...bù shǎode cài na!: NA is not a new word — it is just a CONTRACTION OF NE AND A. You have learned that ne is the marker of absence of change. Here it has a SPECIAL FUNCTION: to show that the speaker is trying to CONVINCE the listener of the GREATNESS of an amount, or of a fact which SURPASSES ORDINARY EXPECTATIONS.

Tāde shōurù bù shǎo ne!          His income is not small (i.e., more than
                                 you would suspect)!
Hǎo rènàode dìfang na!           What a lively place!
Kàn tā nàme niánqīng, hái néng   Isn't it something that someone as young
qù zuò jiàoshòu ne!              as he can be a professor!
Zhème dàde rén hái kū na!        Imagine, such a grown-up person crying!
